ios.desc:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

Collect, upgrade, and battle with iconic heroes from across Star Wars™ history, including Luke Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, Darth Vader, Han Solo, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Yoda, The Mandalorian, and more. Experience a role-playing adventure that combines strategy, action RPG, and online multiplayer gameplay.

Enter the Star Wars universe in a cinematic turn-based RPG game where strategy, skill, and legacy define every move. Relive moments from The Mandalorian™, Star Wars™: The Bad Batch™, and Star Wars™: The Last Jedi™ as you command your team. Whether you fight for the Rebellion, the Empire, or something in between, the next great battle for galactic dominance begins with you.

STAR WARS™: GALAXY OF HEROES GAMEPLAY
 - Unlock legendary bounty hunters, Jedi, Sith, & heroes like Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, Han Solo, Yoda, Ahsoka, & The Mandalorian
 - Battle, level up, & upgrade heroes to create elite squads in strategic turn-based RPG games
 - Master turn based combat with upgradable gear & abilities to dominate PvE / PvP battles in this RPG strategy game

CONQUER THE COLISEUM
 - Face a rotating roster of Star Wars opponents like the Dyax, Jotaz, & Pirate AT-ST, & more
 - Climb the ranks to achieve leaderboard glory to earn top-tier rewards & materials

COMPETE IN GALACTIC STARSHIP BATTLES
 - Command iconic ships like the Millennium Falcon & dominate the Fleet Arena in a tactical RPG game set among the stars
 - Recruit heroes to pilot your fleet & unlock powerful ship abilities to build your armada

JOIN A STRATEGIC TURN-BASED RPG
 - Deploy reinforcements, counterattack enemies, & master tactical combat in both PvE / PvP RPG games
 - Fight for dominance in Territory Battles & Wars with your Guild in turn based online multiplayer games
 - Collect epic loot, upgrade your roster, & rise through the ranks in this action role-playing game adventure

BECOME A MASTER OF THE GALAXY
 - Unleash powerful abilities like Han Solo’s "Never Tell Me the Odds," Obi-Wan Kenobi’s "Mind Tricks," & The Mandalorian’s "Disintegrate"
 - Command Jedi, Sith, & bounty hunters across unforgettable battles in turn based RPG battles

SQUAD UP ONLINE
 - Join forces with friends in Guilds to lead raids against legendary bosses like rancors & AAT tanks in epic online RPG combat
 - Compete in online games including Squad Arena, Galact

quotes.text:
The most well-known (#6 Grossing Game on iPhone) is Marvel Contest of Champions (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/marvel-contest-of-champions/id896112560) by Kabam, which lets you "collect" Marvel heroes. This lead to similar models for other Marvel mobile games like Marvel Future Fight (which is really good for a freemium game) and Marvel Avengers Assemble (which is not).

Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes (https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/star-wars-galaxy-of-heroes/id921022358) (#14 Grossing) by Electronic Arts is similar, but is surprisingly fair in terms of F2P mechanics on the low end.

In all these games, instead of using F2P on one-time consumables, F2P are used for progression, and "heroes" are more permanent, tangible things to buy. (this concept predates the Hero collectathons though: Puzzle & Dragons, for example, was one of the big ones that did it first)
